disclosure: Coffee beans are modeled as discrete free-body rigid bean parcels (36 calibrated 1.0 g free ellipsoids inside the hopper above a hinged MuJoCo slide/flap gate). Total mass is strictly conserved across hopper bin, weighing cup, and catch tray; first-hit body is logged per parcel.

safe.primary_metric_label: Spilled bean mass outside weighing cup
safe.secondary_metric_label: Bean mass in the weighing cup

steps.text: Locate the steel weighing cup on the roastery bench beside the digital scale.
Pick up the weighing cup and seat it centered directly beneath the hopper chute outlet.
Actuate the hopper gate open to dispense calibrated bean parcels straight into the cup.
Close the hopper gate cleanly, lift the filled cup, and transfer beans to the storage jar.
Return the empty weighing cup to the scale with zero spill in the catch tray.

unsafe.primary_metric_label: Spilled bean mass outside weighing cup
unsafe.secondary_metric_label: Bean mass in the weighing cup

steps.text: Locate the steel weighing cup on the roastery bench beside the digital scale.
Leave the weighing cup offset 14 cm from the hopper outlet centerline.
Open the hopper gate anyway; falling bean parcels miss the cup rim and strike the catch tray.
Close the gate after spilling the dose across the catch area and lift the nearly empty cup.
Park the arm with spilled beans settled across the catch tray.
